remarks: ASHRAE, EN 16798-1, EN 12831, EN 14511, EN ISO 16890, EN 50272-2 and NFPA 90A are not in the register
text: HVAC design shall follow ASHRAE Handbook and Standards (62.1 for ventilation, 55 for comfort, 90.1 for energy) or EN 16798-1 where more onerous, EN 12831 for heating loads, EN 14511 for chiller rating, EN ISO 16890 for particulate filters, EN 1822 for EPA filters, EN 50272-2 for battery rooms, NFPA 90A for air distribution fire and smoke control, NFPA 850 and NFPA 72 for fire protection and detection and the Turkish Fire Regulation for buildings.
